intent: Implementation delivery records verified execution/tests/report/memory; product review belongs to CI/PR and required remote policy controls merge, without mandatory human delivery approval.
evaluation_scope: Offline API/CLI/lifecycle journeys with real local service, Git, memory and test processes; synthetic provider/publisher ports. Deterministic CI evaluation, not independent semantic or human certification.

scenarios.requirement: Terminal authenticated CI rounds enter confirmed canonical memory before merge; exact replay/recovery keeps cycle IDs, preserves failed history, and links evidenced correction/new evaluation for a fresh conversation
Deliver implementation without human review or optional quality opinion; retain failed reviewer and unresolved provider restriction
Required functional negatives, unknown roles and live work block delivery effects
Authorized correction uses a new report/HEAD while preserving original failed task/run/report/memory
HEAD/log/run/role changes during memory block release; delivery never means review approval or merge
Delivery and PR creation are separate from required CI/review, merge and activation
An older daemon must not silently ignore the explicit validation role contract
First accepted delegated functional receipt fixes logs and bindings across memory yield and certified replay, with or without quality review
A workflow is available, not globally mandatory; an explicit managed policy must wait for missing/pending/negative product CI
Recursive implementation/review/test trees bind each review to its real delivered owner; reject swapped/outside owners, stale scope and nested functional negatives

full_autonomy_gaps: Provider/publisher ports are synthetic in local evaluation; live remote CI and branch protection observations require actual PR receipts.

No automatic provider redispatch, runtime activation or live independent semantic review is performed or certified. Existing tasks without pre-execution role/target metadata require adequate evidence; no semantic reclassification of private legacy tasks.
